name: Sore Ike! Chinporter! ~Shinshutsukibotsu na Ore no Are~
original_name: それイケ！ ちんぽーたー！ ～神出鬼没な俺のアレ～
source:
One day, the main character went to a live performance of the underground idol Mai Hanatsuka. Mai, a spiritual character, performed, "May my prince of destiny be given a special power to rescue me."

Was that the cause? 

After that, the hero suddenly developed a new power. It's teleporting ability! However, it was lmited in specific ways. 

It's a completely useless ability to save the world and people, but that doesn't matter! With this power, you can do whatever you want with women anytime, anywhere! Your desires are more important than people's happiness or world peace!
translation:
有一天，主角去看了地下偶像花冢舞的现场表演。灵性人物麦表演道：“愿我的命运王子获得特殊的力量来拯救我。”

是这个原因吗？

之后，英雄突然获得了新的力量。这就是瞬移能力！但是，它在特定方面受到限制。

拯救世界和人民是完全没用的能力，不过那没关系！有了这个力量，你就可以随时随地对女人为所欲为！你的愿望比人民的幸福、世界的和平更重要！
